bullets.text: Windows 11 Insider Preview Build 28020.1362 Released - New gaming features enhance handheld experiences on **Windows 11** devices.
Critical CVE-2025-55182 Vulnerability Identified - Affects **React Server Components**, allowing remote code execution via malicious requests.
GPT-5.2 Now in Microsoft 365 Copilot - Enhanced reasoning and efficiency for complex business challenges and everyday tasks.
Microsoft Named Leader in AI Defense - Recognized for enterprise-ready security and governance capabilities in **Generative AI**.
New Themes Department in Microsoft Store - Over 400 themes available for personalizing **Windows** devices.
Azure Storage Innovations Unveiled - Enhancements support AI lifecycle and massive data workloads for organizations.
Windows Terminal Enhanced with GitHub Copilot CLI - Streamlined command line experience for developers using **Windows Terminal**.
Imposter Cyberattacks on the Rise - Cybercriminals posing as employees to gain access to sensitive data.
Shai-Hulud 2.0 Supply Chain Attack Analysis - Highlights risks of compromised npm packages and cloud-native ecosystems.
New JavaScript/TypeScript Modernizer Tool - AI-assisted modernization for **VS Code** projects simplifies upgrades.
